🚫 Red Lines (Never Crossed)

  • ❌ No automated nuclear safety decisions without human ONR inspector review and sign-off
  • ❌ No smart grid AI that discriminates by postcode, income, or protected characteristics
  • ❌ No hydrogen safety AI overrides without mandatory human safety engineer authorisation
  • ❌ No sharing of individual household energy consumption data without explicit consent
  • ❌ No energy AI that undermines national grid stability or creates systemic resilience risk
  • ❌ No automated energy tariff changes without consumer notification and cooling-off period
